title: Tell me about new Messenger messages
summary: When someone writes to your Facebook Page, tell the owner or a team on WhatsApp, Telegram or email, once a day for each person.
description: When someone writes to your Facebook Page, Taskiem tells the owner (or the members with a role you choose) on the WhatsApp or Telegram they linked, or by email, so nobody is left waiting. It says once a day for each person that there is a new conversation, without the message itself: open Messenger or Meta Business Suite to read and reply.
